description: brief-14 built a working 2-CTA thread-block-cluster megakernel for n=512 (routes dense512/mixed512/lapdense_even512) but stalled at 0.44x cuSOLVER behind TWO measured walls: 25% occupancy (2x128KB packed-FP16 > 228KB SMEM/SM) and a tridiagonalization that is 73% of the kernel -- 510 serial per-column symv + cluster.sync cycles in FP32-SIMT. Crack the 73% wall: replace the per-column tridiag with a BLOCKED compact-WY PANEL tridiagonalization whose trailing two-sided update A-VW^T-WV^T is a TENSOR-CORE (TF32/FP16) GEMM across the cluster's distributed SMEM, cutting the cluster.sync count ~NBx and moving the O(n^3) reduction work onto tensor cores; also move the FP32-SIMT back-transform GEMMs (22%) to tensor cores. Do NOT use FP8 matrix storage -- brief-17 just refuted it (2-CTA ALU/barrier contention makes the kernel slower AND FP8's 3-bit mantissa forces 100% orth-gate fallback). Route n=512 dense-majority shapes (esp. shape 11 lapack_dense_even512, the single biggest geomean term at ~207ms, full-rank-flat so no low-rank/gap shortcut exists) with per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback. Forks brief-14 best 4d4a611c so the cluster infra (parametric C via -DCLUST_C, no-atomic symmetric dot-product symv, warp-shuffle reductions, balanced-pivot bounds) is reused. -O2 not -O3; no 'stream' substring; do not regress the megakernel shapes 1/2.

t1: blocked compact-WY (latrd) tridiag in the 2-CTA cluster megakernel replacing the per-column two-sided rank-2 update. Panel of NB=16 reflectors V + W-vectors as n*NB FP32 SMEM tiles; deferred trailing update A[j+NB:,j+NB:]-=VW^T+WV^T applied once per panel (SIMT). Critical SMEM-LAYOUT FIX: cluster-exchanged buffers (v,p,Vp,Wp) FIRST at fixed offset (map_shared_rank needs matching offsets; the two balanced CTAs' packed sizes differ). Algorithm verified correct vs numpy (d/e match to FP16). MEASURED direct on shape 11 b640: NB=16 raw 219ms/call vs cuSOLVER 213ms (no SIMT speed win); fallback 640/640 (FP16 tridiag eig residual over gate). NB=1 (~unblocked) orth 0.0025 passes but eig 0.039 fails; NB=32 overflows SMEM. NOT ROUTED (_CLUST_ROUTE_ENABLED=False) -> geomean 39875 == parent (quiet run), no regression.

t2: __threadfence() before cluster.sync() at the blocked-panel cross-CTA pgm reductions (s2/alpha + the NEW tk/uk matvec-correction dots). Fixes a cross-CTA global-memory VISIBILITY RACE (peer read stale pgm -> invalid reflectors tau*v^Tv!=2): now DETERMINISTIC (run1==run2 bitwise, a broken col went tau*vtv 14.78->2.0). INCOMPLETE: batch=32 shape3(cond2)=nan, shape11 orth~82 -> more cross-CTA races remain in the pgm reductions (robust fix = move ALL cross-CTA reductions to the DSMEM map_shared_rank exchange used for v/p). Routing OFF -> geomean 42302 == parent (contention-inflated run; trial-1 quiet=39875), no regression. DECISIVE: shape 11 is FP16-PRECISION-WALLED -- the correct PARENT unblocked kernel gives eig residual 2.27 (227%) >> 1.2% gate -> 100% fallback; TF32/FP16 tensor cores share the 10-bit mantissa so cannot fix it (catastrophic cancellation reducing a full even spectrum to ulp). No routable shape: 3/8/9 already won by faster low-rank/two-level.

Built the brief's primary structural ask: BLOCKED compact-WY (latrd) tridiagonalization in the 2-CTA cluster megakernel, replacing the per-column two-sided rank-2 update. 2 trials committed+logged, both NOT ROUTED (geomean==parent, no regression). Key measured results:

(1) Algorithm CORRECT (blocked latrd d/e match numpy reference to FP16). Required a critical SMEM-LAYOUT FIX: cluster-exchanged buffers (v,p,panel tiles Vp/Wp) must live at a FIXED offset identical across CTAs for map_shared_rank to resolve (the two balanced CTAs' packed-Ah sizes differ, so Ah-first put v at different per-CTA offsets and peer reads fetched garbage).

(2) SPEED (SIMT trailing update): NB=16 raw kernel 219ms/call ~= cuSOLVER 213ms on shape 11 -- NO speed win from SIMT. The trailing update is ~half the tridiag; a tensor-core (TF32) trailing GEMM could reach ~140ms (would beat cuSOLVER) but is NOT built. NB=32 overflows the 228KB SMEM (panel tiles 2*n*NB); occupancy stays 25% (SMEM-capped).

(3) DECISIVE ACCURACY WALL on shape 11: the brief's premise that brief-14's cluster kernel was 'correct 0/640 on shape 11' is REFUTED -- the correct, deterministic PARENT unblocked kernel gives eig residual 2.27 (227%) >> the 1.2% harness gate on shape 11 -> 100% fallback. lapack_dense_even512 is a full even spectrum down to ulp; the FP16 reduction loses it to catastrophic cancellation. TF32/FP16 tensor cores share FP16's 10-bit mantissa, so moving work to tensor cores CANNOT fix this (it is a precision, not throughput, wall). Rayleigh-L / Newton-Schulz recovery also fails (NS diverges from the broken basis).

(4) NO ROUTABLE SHAPE exists for the cluster kernel: shape 11 is precision-walled; the other n=512 dense shapes (3 dense-cond2, 8 rankdef, 9 clustered) are already won by faster low-rank(~130ms)/two-level(~70ms) paths the 219ms kernel cannot beat.

(5) My blocked kernel has cross-CTA global-visibility RACES in the pgm reductions (the NEW tk/uk matvec-correction dots). t2 added __threadfence() which made it DETERMINISTIC and fixed some cases (a broken tau*v^Tv 14.78->2.0) but batch=32 still fails -> more races remain.

OPEN DIRECTIONS for the manager (I did not pursue these -- off-brief or out of budget):
 - Fully DE-RACE the blocked kernel by moving ALL cross-CTA reductions onto the DSMEM map_shared_rank exchange the kernel already uses for v/p (cluster.sync orders it without manual fences). Then it is a correct, reusable blocked-latrd cluster component.
 - Build the TENSOR-CORE (TF32 WMMA) trailing GEMM to measure the real speed ceiling (~140ms?) -- but note it has no routable target given (3)/(4).
 - The REAL lever for shape 11 is PRECISION, not the cluster kernel: a reduction that keeps higher dynamic range within the SMEM budget (BF16 has FP32 range but 7-bit mantissa; a split-precision / compensated reduction; or a genuinely BATCHED tensor-core eigensolver across the 640 matrices -- brief-1's territory -- that fills the 148 SMs instead of the 25%-occupancy 2-CTA cluster). Shape 11 (207ms, biggest geomean term) needs one of these to move at all.
